supports: On this fixed META pair, P2 is the clearest public read because it best separates repeated AI/privacy scaffolds from newly concrete 2025 enforcement and liability specifics.
Holding the tagged packet fixed shows that protocol framing alone changes how decision-useful the first read feels on the same evidence substrate.
A matrix-first public case can still teach explicit answer shape, proof, and stop without requiring public outline compare.
The public value here is visible judgment about sharpened specifics, not broad AI-theme recitation.
does_not_yet_support: This is not a benchmark-grade claim about all frontier models, all prompt families, or all platform-risk filings.
It does not prove that every repeated AI topic is genuinely new or deserves the same answer shape.
It does not justify shipping the manual-review-only outline-compare artifacts for META in this pass.
why_02_is_hero: P2 stays first because it most clearly turns named 2025 enforcement, liability, and AI-security specifics into a bounded public claim.
why_03_is_main_comparator: P1 uses the same tagged packet as P2, so the main variable is answer shape rather than evidence substrate.
why_00_is_control: P0 keeps the same tagged packet but shows what a simpler prompt does to specificity, prioritization, and stop discipline.
why_01_is_secondary: No separate 01 lane is shipped in this pass; the public matrix intentionally stops at P2, P1, and P0.
